description: This file defines the LocalSiloHealthMonitor class responsible for monitoring the health of the local node in an Orleans cluster. It includes heuristics to assess health degradation based on node status, network responses, thread pool delays, and custom health checks. The class implements interfaces for lifecycle participation, health assessment, and health complaints reporting.

classes.name: LocalSiloHealthMonitor
classes.description: Monitors the health of the local Orleans silo node using multiple heuristics, including checking node status, network probes, thread pool delays, and custom health check participants. It computes a degradation score and maintains complaints for external access. Implements lifecycle participation and health monitoring interfaces.

classes.name: ThreadPoolMonitor
classes.description: A helper class within LocalSiloHealthMonitor that measures delays in the .NET thread pool queue, which can indicate resource starvation or long GC pauses.

methods.name: GetLocalHealthDegradationScore
methods.description: Calculates the health degradation score based on heuristics like suspecting nodes, thread pool delay, received probes, and health check participants. Returns a score between 0 (healthy) and MaxScore (unhealthy).

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Asynchronous loop periodically checking the local silo's health, updating the complaints array based on current heuristics.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the monitor to the silo's lifecycle stages to start and stop health monitoring accordingly.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Starts the monitoring loop task, marking the component as active.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops the monitoring loop, disposes resources, and marks the component as inactive.
